Hotel Santika Premiere Dyandra - Medan

The 4-star Santika Premiere Dyandra Hotel & Convention Medan features top-class accommodations and the city’s largest convention centre. Medan is the centre of government and commercial activity for Indonesia’s western region. Despite being one of Indonesia’s largest melting pot cities, this historic city has retained much of its old-world charm.

Starts from Rp807.500

Amaris Hotel Slipi - Jakarta

Amaris Hotel Slipi – Jakarta is now ready to be your smart accomodation choice in Jakarta! Located strategically in Slipi, West Jakarta with only 35 minutes drive from the airport. Surrounded by high class shopping centre such as Taman Anggrek Mall, Central Park and walking distance to major hospitals such as Harapan Kita Hospital and Dharmais Hospital

Starts from Rp400.200
View Hotel
Hotel Santika Premiere Bandara - Palembang

The ancient capital of the rich and powerful Srivijaya kingdom, Palembang was once a wealthy trade hub and renowned center of Buddhism. Visited by traders and holy men from as far afield as China and India, the city was awash in gold, spices, silks, ivories and ceramics. Today, Palembang is a dynamic and modern city, but evidence of its past glory can still be seen in the fine songket weaving that persists until today, as well as its renowned lacquerware, regal dances and opulent costumes. Business and leisure travelers seeking the many up-market comforts of a top-quality hotel will find all these and more at our four-star Hotel Santika Premiere Bandara – Palembang, where world-class standards of service are seamlessly combined with a uniquely Indonesian touch.

Starts from Rp862.400
View Hotel
Amaris Hotel Citra Raya - Tangerang

Tangerang has become an integral part of the Jabodetabek (Greater Jakarta) region since it is a thriving commercial center which is also closed to Soekarno-Hatta airport. Understanding the demands of smart and reliable accommodation, The Amaris Hotel Citra Raya is here to provide affordable comfort that helps travelers to ensure the convenience of their journey. The hotel comes with a modern vibe that will give the value of money while granting a convenient staying experience.

Starts from Rp506.300
View Hotel
Hotel Santika Premiere Slipi - Jakarta

With its distinctive yet understated Indonesian ambience, Hotel Santika Premiere Slipi Jakarta offers exceptional facilities, a variety of dining options including restaurants and an Executive Lounge with a wide selection of menu choices, as well as warm and attentive service. The hotel is a perfect destination for a wide range of events, from intimate cocktail gatherings to grand banquets, as well as business activities such as training sessions, board meetings, and seminars. Adding to its lifestyle facilities, the hotel now introduces San-Padel Court, a modern padel court designed for anyone looking to stay active and enjoy an exciting sporting experience in the city. The court features convenient free parking access, and free locker rooms to ensure a seamless and enjoyable game. Make your reservation now through Courtside and enjoy an exclusive padel experience in the heart of Jakarta.

Starts from Rp793.000
